programs.title: The Dog House
programs.desc: Frankie the Chihuahua plays it cool when he meets best friends Paulette and Jackie. And can glamorous poodle cross Lola live up to five-year-old Violet's expectations.

programs.title: Where the Crawdads Sing
programs.desc: Daisy Edgar-Jones stars in director Olivia Newman's adaptation of Delia Owens' best-selling novel about a feral child who's accused of murder in America's Deep South. Did she do it.

programs.title: Grand Designs
programs.desc: Pep and Malene are building a modern Viking Hall in the Surrey Hills. Following Pep's cancer diagnosis, it's a race to create a house that cherishes their memories and life together.
